title: Circuit Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2509.25002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model distillation typically focuses on behavioral mimicry, where a student model is trained to replicate a teacher's output while treating its internal computations as a black box. In this work we propose an alternative approach: Distilling the underlying computational mechanisms implemented by a teacher model. Specifically, we propose circuit distillation, which introduces an objective to align internal representations between analogous circuit components in teacher and student models. We propose a method to match ``functionally correspondent'' circuit components and introduce a loss reflecting similarities between the representations that these induce. We evaluate circuit distillation on entity tracking and theory of mind (ToM) tasks using models from the Llama3 family. translated_abstract: 模型蒸馏通常侧重于行为模仿，即训练学生模型复现教师模型的输出，而将教师模型的内部计算视为黑箱。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种替代方法：蒸馏教师模型所实现的底层计算机制。具体而言，我们提出了电路蒸馏，该方法引入了一个目标，用于对齐教师模型和学生模型中相似电路组件的内部表示。我们提出了一种匹配“功能对应”电路组件的方法，并引入了一个反映这些组件所诱导表示之间相似性的损失函数。我们在Llama3系列的模型上，针对实体跟踪和心理理论（ToM）任务评估了电路蒸馏。我们的结果表明，电路蒸馏优于标准蒸馏，仅需调整少量（参数）即可成功迁移算法能力。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“电路蒸馏”的新方法，通过匹配教师与学生模型中功能对应的电路组件并对齐其内部表示，实现了底层计算机制的蒸馏，在仅调整少量参数的情况下成功迁移算法能力，性能优于传统的行为模仿式标准蒸馏。
en_tdlr: Proposes "circuit distillation," which matches functionally correspondent circuit components between teacher and student models and aligns their internal representations, successfully transferring algorithmic capabilities by tuning only a small subset of parameters and outperforming standard behavioral-mimicry distillation.
